Thanks for the context. I've reviewed the worksheet and Raman's resume. A few notes from Total Rewards:

- Our standard range for the posted L5 is base $170k–$195k; L6 ranges base $200k–$230k. Marcus's proposed $210k base sits inside L6 but at the high end when combined with signing and equity.
- Exceptions to the posted level require: hiring manager justification, candidate market comp evidence (benchmarks), and one-up approval (VP/Engineering leadership).

Can you attach two benchmark comps (LinkedIn/levels.fyi or market comp sheets)? Also confirm relocation/visa needs (won't affect base logic if remote US). If leadership is comfortable, Total Rewards can approve the L6 band but we need a written one-up sign-off for record-keeping.

Provisional recommendation: Approve L6 base $205k–$210k, signing bonus 10–15% instead of 15% (to keep total comp in policy bands), 0.15% equity. If Marcus can confirm mission-critical deliverables and Vivek signs off, we can proceed.

-Karthik
